name: Soil
description: A defensive, HP-focused earth blade that gradually evolves from a crude dirt blade into an indestructible soil fortress.

phases.name: Phase 1: Loose Dirt
phases.effects: Tiny crude blade fashioned from loose topsoil. Base 3 DMG and 250 HP.
phases.notification: I'm... just dirt. But I'll protect what I can.

phases.name: Phase 2: Gathering Soil
phases.effects: More dirt gathers around the blade, thickening its frame. Base 15 DMG and 800 HP.
phases.notification: The soil is gathering around me. I'm becoming harder to break.

phases.name: Phase 3: Hardened Earth
phases.effects: The dirt becomes compact and visibly hardened. Base 50 DMG and 2,000 HP.
phases.notification: I won't scatter so easily anymore. Something precious lies behind me.

phases.name: Phase 4: Earthen Guard
phases.effects: Dense earth blade with protective earthen guard. Unlocks Fortitude [Z] (15% current HP Shield for 5s). Base 150 DMG and 5,500 HP.
phases.notification: I understand now. My strength exists to protect.

phases.name: Phase 5: Deep Foundation
phases.effects: Heavier foundation with deep compacted soil strata. Base 350 DMG and 12,000 HP.
phases.notification: My foundation runs deeper. Strike me. I will endure.

phases.name: Phase 6: Dense Earth
phases.effects: Soil becomes extremely dense and resembles stone-like earth. Base 750 DMG and 25,000 HP.
phases.notification: Every battle adds another layer. Every layer makes me stronger.

phases.name: Phase 7: Earth Fortress
phases.effects: Large fortress-like formations begin growing around the blade. Base 1,500 DMG and 55,000 HP.
phases.notification: I'm becoming more than a sword. I'm becoming a wall.

phases.name: Phase 8: Immovable
phases.effects: Massive hardened-earth structures surround the blade like fortress walls. Base 3,000 DMG and 120,000 HP.
phases.notification: Nothing moves me now. Nothing reaches what I protect.

phases.name: Phase 9: Collapse
phases.effects: DELIBERATE COLLAPSE. The hardened earth cracks and falls apart. Base 135 DMG and 5,000 HP. Walk speed increases to 96. Requires +900 kills to reconstruct.
phases.notification: No... My foundation... is breaking. But soil never truly disappears.

phases.name: Phase 10: Indestructible Soil Fortress
phases.effects: FINAL TRANSFORMATION: INDESTRUCTIBLE SOIL FORTRESS. Colossal fortress sword. Base 8,500 DMG, 315,000 HP, and 120 SPD. Unyielding wall protecting your treasure.
phases.notification: As long as I stand... Your treasure will never be taken.
